node.textContent: Pursuant to section 4.16 of the Environmental Planning and Assessment Act 1979
) cannot proceed until the following conditions are met:
• Utility Connection Confirmation: Missing required document
• Proof of Application Fee Payment: Missing required document
• Site Survey Plan (1:200 or 1:500 scale): Survey does not show the drainage easement along the northern boundary. An updated survey is required.
• Architectural Plans and Building Specifications: Rear setback is not dimensioned on the ground floor plan. The DCP requires a minimum of 6 m.
• Architectural Plans and Building Specifications: Finished floor levels are not shown relative to the 1% AEP flood level.
• Stormwater drainage concept: On-site detention calculations are not provided for the increase in impervious area.
• Heritage impact statement: The site adjoins a heritage item. A heritage impact statement is required before the referral can be completed.
Please address these issues and resubmit the required documentation.
